mapper.sql: statistic_total_product AS ( SELECT pb.product_id AS productId, sum(pb.quantity) AS totalProductQuantity FROM product_batch pb GROUP BY pb.product_id )
mapper.select: WITH SELECT ci.id as id, ci.quantity as quantity, p.product_image as productImage, p.name as productName, p.price as productPrice, p.id as productId, p.sold as productSold, stp.totalProductQuantity as quantityInStock, CASE WHEN pr.start_time <= date(NOW()) AND pr.end_time >= date(NOW()) AND pr.is_active = true THEN p.price - pr.discount_price ELSE p.price END AS productPriceAfterDiscount FROM cart_item ci INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id LEFT JOIN statistic_total_product stp ON stp.productId = p.id LEFT JOIN promotion pr ON pr.product_id = p.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId}
